question: Does explicit LLD/ThinLTO concurrency one change link-stage RSS, time, or filesystem peak for the unchanged ordinary Release engine inputs?
preserved: Release, -O3, -DNDEBUG, -flto=thin, current LLD LTO optimization defaults
current LTO codegen partition count and no added ThinLTO cache or save-temps
same native306 and diagnostic2 source bytes, compile flags and object/archive inputs
same WASI-SDK30 LLVM21.1.4, Rust lock, OpenSSL bytes and embedding patches
same WEVAL=OFF, USE_WASM_OPT=ON and post-link wasm-opt arguments
strict, protected-event layout and internal-tick compile definitions
ordinary public typed component ABI, full validation scope and exact WASI allowlist
prior artifacts, source/config freezes, policies and acceptance records
sequence: Review a new finite producer/policy: existing recipe and metadata are not relabeled.
Capture exact tools, source/native306+diagnostic2, object/archive inputs, configuration, target commands, launcher and measurement-tool versions.
Verify the control and candidate driver print-only commands differ solely by the two LLD arguments, with unchanged wasm-opt invocation.
When original gates are satisfied, run isolated serial link-stage trials from the same inputs in opposite arm order; plan at least two complete pairs when capacity permits.
Measure resources independently for the linker, enclosing command and post-link wasm-opt; preserve raw observations and any threshold stop or failure as such.
Rehash inputs and original artifacts after every trial, record output SHA/size and compare outputs without presuming byte identity.
If adopted for a new full ordinary Release/Release-GC artifact, freeze actual commands/configs/source/licenses and rerun all applicable component and host gates before acceptance.

measurements.elapsedSeconds: monotonic host timer for each stage
measurements.processPeakRssBytes: host per-process maximum, record platform units and method
measurements.sampledProcessGroupRssBytes: bounded sampling with observed PID membership, sampling interval, lifetime limitations and no claim of an exact simultaneous peak
measurements.freeFilesystemBytes: before, periodically during, minimum observed, and after; global observations are nonexclusive
measurements.temporaryAndOutputBytes: exact owned paths and logical/allocated sizes, distinguish memory pressure from disk pressure
measurements.threadCount: sample linker process threads to confirm the requested cap is operational, noting other threads/runtime infrastructure
measurements.artifact: SHA256, logical bytes, emitted imports/exports, full ordinary correctness results

explicitExclusions: native build or guest execution by this packet
DEBUG, fault injection, stopped OOM branch or raw/malformed memory observation
weaker optimization, stripped diagnostic functionality or reduced test coverage
host modifications, custom capabilities or access-tier changes
